reference: none — the corpus has no editorial reference (see EVALUATION_SET.md)

candidates.name: Committed field (reference-faithful)
principles: Brand hue owns a real field (hero), not just buttons
Content sheet overlaps the field — the overlap is the brand gesture
Product visuals lead; chrome stays quiet
candidates.tradeoffs: Highest fidelity when the reference commits its hue to large fields. The field colour must carry white text at >=4.5:1, which constrains the brand shade.
candidates.recommendedWhen: saturationRegime is committed (sat>=0.25 over ~25% of the board): the reference spends its hue on fields, so the app should too.

candidates.name: Neutral gallery
principles: Ground stays neutral; colour delegated to product visuals
Brand appears only on actions and selection
Hierarchy from typography and spacing alone
candidates.tradeoffs: Safest and cleanest, and the right reading when the reference rations its hue to actions and state. Risks reading as generic if the brand accent is weak.
candidates.recommendedWhen: saturationRegime is neutral or mixed: the reference keeps its ground quiet and delegates colour to actions, selection and state.

candidates.name: Dark board (photo-board-led)
principles: The reference's dark photo boards become the ground
Brand hue becomes the accent rather than the field
Maximum mood; product visuals glow against the dark
candidates.tradeoffs: Distinctive, but inverts a light reference into a dark app and taxes body-text contrast everywhere. Only defensible when the reference's own ground is dark.
candidates.recommendedWhen: groundValue is dark: the reference's canvas itself is dark, not merely accented.
